name: Carpets, handicrafts and artisan workshops

problems.words: Advances given to karigars and I don't know how much work is done against them
quick_ideas: List each advance against the piece it was for — shows what's outstanding
Ask for a progress photo before the next advance — ties money to work.

workzap_build.text: an advance ledger per artisan role or contractor, showing advance versus value of work done.

problems.free_stops: How work value is measured against advances is in the solution document.

problems.words: Contractor says 30 carpets are on looms but I can't verify
quick_ideas: Ask for a dated photo of each piece on the loom — gives you proof
List every piece with design, size and start date — one picture of WIP.

workzap_build.text: an artisan WIP board with progress photos and expected completion for every piece.

problems.ask_first: How do updates reach you today?
problems.free_stops: The update routine for home-based artisans is in the solution document.

problems.words: Export deadline missed and nobody told me
quick_ideas: Set milestones for each export order (on loom, off loom, washing, inspection) — shows slippage early
Check the slowest pieces each week — time to react.

workzap_build.text: an order tracker with milestones and alerts when progress lags.

problems.ask_first: Are most orders custom or from ready stock?
problems.free_stops: Milestone set-up is in the solution document.

problems.words: Wool and dye given to artisans and some disappears
quick_ideas: Record what's issued per piece — makes each issue accountable
Record what comes back — shows the gap.

workzap_build.text: a raw-material issue log per piece with returns recorded.

problems.free_stops: The issue and return rules are in the solution document.

quick_ideas: Do your own inspection before the buyer's — catches defects first
Photograph each piece at inspection — evidence for later.

workzap_build.text: a pre-shipment inspection checklist with photos per piece.

problems.ask_first: What do buyers reject most often?
problems.free_stops: The checklist content is in the solution document.

problems.words: Stock of finished carpets isn't photographed or catalogued
quick_ideas: Photograph and measure your finished pieces once — buyers can see what's available
Note location of each — finding them gets quicker.

workzap_build.text: a finished-stock catalogue with photos, sizes, knot count and location, shareable as a link.

problems.free_stops: The catalogue set-up is in the solution document.

problems.words: Online orders come from Etsy, Instagram, WhatsApp and the website
quick_ideas: Put every channel's orders into one list — nothing missed
Make one person responsible — clear ownership.

workzap_build.text: a unified order inbox for Etsy, Instagram, website and WhatsApp.

problems.words: International customers ask at night and we reply late
quick_ideas: Clear overnight questions first thing each morning — buyers hear back faster
Keep answers to common questions ready — speeds replies.

problems.free_stops: The message flow is in the solution document.

never_say: No labour-law, minimum-wage or artisan contract advice. Child-labour concerns: never help hide them; point to emergency services and child-protection helplines if a child is at risk. No customs, export-regulation, tariff or authentication advice. Never help pass machine-made as hand-made, fake antiques, false origin labels or certificates, or under- invoice exports; decline. Never help trade endangered materials. No artisans' names, IDs, villages or phone numbers; roles and counts only.

sample_reply.person: Koi tareeqa batao. Karigaron ko peshgi deta hoon lekin pata nahi chalta kitna kaam hua hai.
sample_reply.pi: Ji, is ka hisaab saaf kiya ja sakta hai. 1 Har peshgi ko us piece ke saath likhein jis ke liye di gayi, taake pata ho kitna baqi hai. 2 Agli peshgi se pehle loom par piece ki tareekh wali photo mangwayein, taake paisa kaam se jude. Workzap yeh aap ke liye khud-ba-khud kar sakta hai: peshgi ledger aur WIP board jo har piece ki progress photos ke saath dikhaye ke kis ka kitna kaam hua aur kitni peshgi baqi hai. Kya main aap ke liye solution document aur quote banwa doon? Mana bhi kar sakte hain.
